problems.title: String Matching in an Array
problems.notes: naive substring matching warm-up — small n makes brute force fine here, before KMP is actually needed

problems.title: Find the Index of the First Occurrence in a String
problems.notes: implement KMP's failure function by hand — this IS the point of the problem, not just calling indexOf

problems.title: Repeated Substring Pattern
problems.notes: KMP failure-function trick: the string is periodic iff n % (n - fail[n-1]) == 0

problems.title: Repeated DNA Sequences
problems.notes: rolling hash (or bit-encode each of ACGT in 2 bits) over fixed-length windows to detect repeats in O(n)

problems.title: Shortest Palindrome
problems.notes: run KMP's failure function on s + '#' + reverse(s) to find the longest palindromic prefix in one pass

problems.title: Longest Happy Prefix
problems.notes: a direct application of the KMP failure array — the answer is just fail[n-1], no searching needed at all

problems.title: Longest Duplicate Substring
problems.notes: binary search on the candidate length + Rabin-Karp rolling hash to check feasibility at each length in O(n)
